checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same sage-green mug in all three
must.why: Breakfast mug is a noticeably darker forest green and glossier-looking; shape is similar but colour doesn't match the white shot or close-up.

must.item: Main image shows whole mug on pure white
must.why: Whole mug, white backdrop with a soft shadow.
Wooden table, warm light, toast, berries, linen, steam.

must.item: Detail image focuses on rim and glaze
must.why: Macro of rim and matte glaze with the handle joint.

faults.what: Breakfast photo mug is dark forest green, not the same sage green as images 1 and 3; breaks the set consistency the user worried about.
Breakfast mug contains coffee and steam, which the user did not ask for, and its handle and proportions are slightly different.
The close-up has a near-white background rather than showing a distinct environment; this is fine, but the handle is cropped.

summary: The white-background shot and the rim close-up are good and match each other, but the breakfast photo's mug is a much darker green, so the set doesn't read as one product.
